task.title: Keep the browser state in a file

step.cmd: Delete any sessions-pstate.json that an earlier run left in the output folder.
Sign in at the sign-in page. The server sets the sessions_pstate cookie.
Save the browser state to sessions-pstate.json.
Sign out at the sign-out page, which replaces the cookie.
Load the browser state from sessions-pstate.json.
Open the cookie report, and check that it shows sessions_pstate=signed-in.
